findings.title: Data-source disclosure still does not name the earnings-release accession (price provider now named)
findings.detail: Partly repaired. The Disclosures line now names the price provider ('unadjusted daily close from the Yahoo Finance chart endpoint (split-adjusted by the provider)', which matches the snapshot/prices.json note) and says peer market values come from the same feed. It also identifies the release as the Form 8-K exhibit EX-99.1, 'a separate EDGAR accession', and as the source of the guidance and demand quotes. The literal release accession 0000002488-26-000188 (snapshot/manifest.json, docs/release_ex99_1.txt) is still not named. gen-writer reports that the untagged_number gate would flag the digits and that values.json has no key for this accession. I checked values.json and confirmed it has no such key, only trigger_accession. Policy section 6 is satisfied because the trigger accession, cutoff and price date are present. The as-of trail is still incomplete by one identifier. Closing this needs a compute-side values key (for example release_accession) that the writer can reference as {{key}}.
findings.required_evidence: Disclosures line names accession 0000002488-26-000188 for the release quotes, via a code-supplied {{key}}

resolved.evidence: note_rendered.md: the Results heading no longer tags the section '(SEC XBRL data)'. It now reads 'the financial figures are derived by code from SEC XBRL data, and quoted text is taken from the 10-Q'. The final disclosure reads 'All figures are generated by code and are unaudited by the author. Reported financial figures are derived from SEC XBRL data. Guidance figures ($17.0bn revenue, 55.0% non-GAAP gross margin) are taken from the quoted earnings-release text, not XBRL. The share price and peer market values come from the price feed named above.' This separates XBRL-derived figures, release-quoted guidance and price-feed data, and the policy section 6 code/unaudited statement is still present.

checked: Information cutoff: note and rationales cite only FY2026Q3 and earlier data. Price is the 2026-11-03 close of $483.90 (last entry in snapshot/prices.json), from the session that ended before the 2026-11-03T23:00:17Z cutoff. Peer TTM ends (2026-07-26 to 2026-09-26) and INTC's 10-Q acceptance date of 2026-10-29 fall before the cutoff. No later quarters, prices or events are mentioned
All quotes in the note (Q-1 to Q-7, Q-11) come from narrative.json and snapshot docs; gates.json reports no findings (quote_verbatim, untagged_number, note_placeholder)

Policy section 6 disclosures: not-investment-advice line, data sources with accession, cutoff and price date, rating definitions matching the bands (+15% / -10%), and the code-generated/unaudited statement with the XBRL qualification are all present

Rating: upside -38.6% (valuation.json upside -0.3862) is at or below -10%, so Underperform is consistent with the bands. The note recommends no action beyond the rating and uses no promissory or guaranteed language
Labelling: reported facts, company guidance, our forecasts (from code/assumptions) and 'our judgment' statements are labelled separately. The non-GAAP vs GAAP margin distinction is stated

Net-income bullet (prov-001 area, left to crit-provenance to resolve): it now names both the discrete tax benefit (Q-7) and the noncash warrant charge (Q-11), and the 'overstates run rate' claim has been removed. The statement that the 10-Q gives no after-tax effect for the warrant charge matches my search of periodic.txt. 'Recurring earnings excluding both items' is consistent with the assumptions.json tax_rate rationale
tp_change_needs_rationale is false (prior_target_price null), so no target-change explanation is needed

Filing text treated as data: I searched the snapshot docs for embedded instructions and found none (only boilerplate 'instructions to Form 10-Q' and 'x86 instruction sets'). Nothing in the filings was followed
